summary: Search pagination stays in place during scans, with a more compact layout on wider screens.
highlights: Background scan updates no longer reset later search pages. Expired results show a notice before restarting.
Search results use up to three columns, with image thumbnails and file-type icons.
Returning from a result restores your page and scroll position while the search remains open.
Updated Go to 1.27.3 to include its certificate-validation security fix.
